source.manualTitle: Samsung NE58F9710WS Flex Duo Electric Range (FER710DRS)

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Disconnect electrical power at breaker before servicing. Replace all panels before operating. 240 VAC present at terminal block when energized.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power before servicing the range. Replace all panels before operating range.

steps.title: Keypad cable TE201
steps.body: Disconnect power. Inspect keypad cable at sub PCB TE201 — -SE- key short path.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power. Inspect keypad cable at sub PCB TE201 — -SE- key short path.

steps.title: Touch glass ↔ sub PCB
steps.body: Verify touch glass connector and TE201 on sub PCB — -tE- communication error path.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Verify touch glass connector and TE201 on sub PCB — -tE- communication error path.

steps.title: Replace touch control PCB
steps.oemOutcome: Replace control box (touch PCB + glass) or sub PCB when harness verified.
